patchNotes: Improved Trick Mapping layout and made previews wait for the complete trick before repeating. Added one-click Studio packages that apply coordinated rider and bike animations, including phase and mirror routing. Manual IK now follows Mash's tracked manual state so ordinary hop landings do not trigger custom poses, while real and fakie manuals retain foot ownership. Added a staged Replay exit recovery when the game's normal Back action gets stuck. Restored native peg-contact sparks with entry bursts, replay samples, and simpler controls. Reorganized Grind Poses into responsive Bike, Rider, Balance, and Transform sections with cached presets. Fixed the host player-capacity nullable conversion that could throw when starting a session. Tested in game with a clean MelonLoader log; build, native-hook audits, and focused animation checks passed.
